record.title: A fully supported local information maximum on the full two-shift
record.statement: Let $(X,T)$ be the full two-shift, let $\alpha$ be the partition used to define information, and consider the space of one-step Markov measures on $X$. A measure is fully supported when every allowed cylinder has positive measure, and a local maximum is understood relative to this space. **Fully supported local-maximum conjecture.** There is a fully supported one-step Markov measure that is a local maximum of $\operatorname{Int}_\mu(X,T,\alpha)$ among all one-step Markov measures. The assertion is suggested by numerical computations in the source; no proof or resolution is supplied.
record.source_name: Karl Petersen, “Measuring Complexity in Cantor Dynamics”, arXiv:1607.02425 (2016).
record.references:
**2 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2015–2016). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:1512.01143](https://arxiv.org/abs/1512.01143).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1607.02425

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of July 2016).
